rules.dependencies: Load necessary cited authorities on demand. B01 loads needed B02 provisions early; B08 reuses B02-B07 releases. Necessary court decisions may be loaded before B10. rules.routing: Document type overrides folder. Rulings and opinions encountered elsewhere resolve to B01/B08; duplicates become source representations, not new legal documents.
